summary_en: This phase II trial tests axelopran, an oral capsule, in adults with advanced breast, lung, pancreas, or prostate cancer who are taking opioid pain medicine. Participants take axelopran capsules by mouth once daily for up to 1 year, or longer if they are deriving benefit. The main outcome is whether axelopran affects cancer control, measured through day 43 (6 weeks) with repeat imaging.
summary_es: Este ensayo de fase II prueba axelopran, una cápsula oral, en adultos con cáncer de mama, de pulmón, de páncreas o de próstata avanzado que toman medicamentos opioides para el dolor. Los participantes toman las cápsulas de axelopran por vía oral una vez al día durante hasta 1 año, o más tiempo si obtienen beneficio. El resultado principal es si axelopran afecta el control del cáncer, medido hasta el día 43 (6 semanas) con estudios de imagen repetidos.
who_for: Advanced breast, lung (non-small cell), pancreas, or prostate cancer that has relapsed or progressed after standard treatment including chemotherapy.
Current opioid use averaging at least 5 mg OME per day over the past 3 days.
At least one measurable lesion meeting RECIST v1.1 criteria.
Life expectancy of at least 2 months at screening.
not_for: Previous gastrointestinal surgery, except uncomplicated appendectomy or cholecystectomy.
Fecal incontinence, irritable bowel syndrome, inflammatory bowel disease, or intestinal obstruction.
Recent use of certain medicines, such as naloxone, buprenorphine, or strong CYP3A4 inhibitors or inducers.
Pregnant or breastfeeding women, or women of childbearing potential not using birth control.
